ValidationRule.description: Require Affiliation for Experience Center, FASS, SBS agents when closing case from functional group Help Desk, Financial Aid, Student Bus Serv; excluding Closed : SPAM and System Administrator, ASU Community, ASU Community CAP, My ASU Profile, DEI
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR (( CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Help Desk" ), ( CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Student Business Services"), ( CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Financial Aid" ) ), Not( AND( CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Help Desk" , OR( CC_Category__r.Name= "DEI-ACP (Help Desk)", CC_Category__r.Name= "DEI-FAR (Help Desk)", CC_Category__r.Name= "DEI-Internet Access (Help Desk)") ) ), (ISBLANK(TEXT( Affiliation__c ))), ($User.ProfileId <> "00ed00000017Iob" && $Profile.Id <> "00ed00000019z5n" && $Profile.Id <> "00ed00000019z5s" && $Profile.Id <> "00ed00000019z77"), OR(ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Cancellation"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Self-Resolved"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Unresponsive"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Duplicate"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Forwarded"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: No Show"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Resolved")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Affiliation is required when the Functional group is Help Desk, Financial Aid or Student Business Services.
